## Schema Reference

All tables are created by `postgres/init.sql` at first launch (with idempotent upgrade migrations in `memory_engine/migrations/`). Tables per pattern:

| Pattern | Tables |
|---------|--------|
| Developer | `dev_code_symbols` |
| Task | `task_trajectories` |
| Enterprise | `enterprise_documents` |
| Tutor | `tutor_skills`, `tutor_user_progress` |
| Swarm | `swarm_blackboard` |
| Companion | `companion_memory_state`, `companion_episodes`, `companion_chunks`, `companion_graph_nodes`, `companion_graph_edges`, `companion_fact_sources`, `companion_ephemerals` |
| Checkpointer | `checkpoints`, `checkpoint_writes`, `checkpoint_blobs` |

Companion graph columns:

| Table | Key Columns | Notes |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| `companion_memory_state` | `user_id`, `enabled`, `generation` | Controls right-to-forget fencing and explicit opt-in resume |
| `companion_graph_nodes` | `user_id`, `name`, `entity_type`, `salience`, `normalize_name_key`, `subject`, `embedding`, `is_subject` | `subject` ∈ `user`/`self`/`shared`; unique on `(user_id, normalize_name_key, subject)` |
| `companion_graph_edges` | `user_id`, `source_node_id`, `target_node_id`, `relationship_type`, `status`, `valid_from`, `valid_until`, `recorded_at`, `subject`, `valence`, `intensity`, `source_episode_id`, `embedding` | `valence` −1…1, `intensity` 0…1; partial unique index on active edges |
| `companion_fact_sources` | `edge_id`, `user_id`, `episode_id` | Multi-episode provenance join table |
| `companion_episodes` | `episode_id`, `user_id`, `content`, `ingestion_id` | Idempotent episode ingestion linked from edges for provenance |

   - Fixed the reversed subject/object seed edges in [`seed_companion_data`](file:///Users/markcastillo/git/pg-agent-memory-demo/demo_agents/main.py#L439-L515) and [test_companion.py](file:///Users/markcastillo/git/pg-agent-memory-demo/tests/test_companion.py) (`name` = subject `"Alex"`, `relationship_to` = object `"TechCorp"` / `"Dark Roast Coffee"`) so `lives_in`/`works_at` conflict detection (Demo 6c) and common-ground detection work end-to-end.

122: def normalize_relation(rel: str | None) -> str | None:
123:     """Fold a free-form relationship type into its canonical predicate."""
124:     if not rel:
125:         return rel
126:     key = normalize_name(rel)
127:     if key in _RELATION_SYNONYMS:
128:         return _RELATION_SYNONYMS[key]
129:     # fall back to a normalized snake_case form of the original text
130:     parts = key.split()
131:     if parts:
132:         return "_".join(parts)
133:     return rel

240: async def _upsert_node(
241:     conn,
242:     user_id: str,
243:     name: str,
244:     entity_type: str,
245:     subject: str = "user",
246:     existing_name: str | None = None,
247:     bump_salience: bool = False,
248: ) -> dict | None:
249:     """Insert a node, or merge into an existing node with the same normalized name."""
250:     key = normalize_name(name)
251: 
252:     # Try to reuse an existing node with the same normalized name (any casing/spelling).
253:     existing = await conn.fetchrow(
254:         """
255:         SELECT node_id, name, entity_type, salience
256:         FROM companion_graph_nodes
257:         WHERE user_id = $1 AND normalize_name_key = $2 AND subject = $3
258:         ORDER BY salience DESC
259:         LIMIT 1
260:         """,
261:         user_id,
262:         key,
263:         subject,
264:     )
265: 
266:     if existing:
267:         if bump_salience:
268:             await conn.execute(
269:                 "UPDATE companion_graph_nodes SET salience = salience + 1, is_subject=true WHERE node_id = $1",
270:                 existing["node_id"],
271:             )
272:         return {
273:             "node_id": existing["node_id"],
274:             "name": existing["name"],
275:             "entity_type": existing["entity_type"],
276:             "salience": existing["salience"],
277:         }
278: 
279:     vector = await _embed(name)
280:     row = await conn.fetchrow(
281:         """
282:         INSERT INTO companion_graph_nodes (user_id, name, entity_type, salience, normalize_name_key, subject, embedding, is_subject)
283:         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 1.0, $4, $5, $6::halfvec, $7)
284:         ON CONFLICT (user_id, normalize_name_key, subject)
285:         DO UPDATE SET entity_type = EXCLUDED.entity_type,
286:                       salience = companion_graph_nodes.salience + 1
287:         RETURNING node_id, name, entity_type, salience
288:         """,
289:         user_id,
290:         name,
291:         entity_type,
292:         key,
293:         subject,
294:         vector,
295:         bump_salience,
296:     )
297:     if row:
298:         return dict(row)
299: 
300:     # Fallback: the (name, entity_type, subject) unique constraint may have
301:     # fired instead (e.g. same name/type under a different normalization). Fetch
302:     # and bump that node.
303:     existing = await conn.fetchrow(
304:         """
305:         SELECT node_id, name, entity_type, salience
306:         FROM companion_graph_nodes
307:         WHERE user_id = $1 AND name = $2 AND entity_type = $3 AND subject = $4
308:         LIMIT 1
309:         """,
310:         user_id,
311:         name,
312:         entity_type,
313:         subject,
314:     )
315:     if existing:
316:         if bump_salience:
317:             await conn.execute(
318:                 "UPDATE companion_graph_nodes SET salience = salience + 1, is_subject=true WHERE node_id = $1",
319:                 existing["node_id"],
320:             )
321:         return {
322:             "node_id": existing["node_id"],
323:             "name": existing["name"],
324:             "entity_type": existing["entity_type"],
325:             "salience": existing["salience"],
326:         }
327:     return None

443: async def get_companion_context(
444:     user_id: str,
445:     request: Request,
446:     query: Optional[str] = None,
447:     limit: int = Query(default=15, ge=1, le=50),

449:     vector = await _embed(query) if query else None
450:     buckets = {}
451:     async with connection(request) as conn:
452:         for subject, key in [
453:             ("user", "graph_facts"),
454:             ("self", "self_facts"),
455:             ("shared", "shared_facts"),
456:         ]:
457:             rows = await conn.fetch(
458:                 """
459:                 WITH edge_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
460:                     SELECT e.* FROM companion_graph_edges e
461:                     WHERE e.user_id=$1 AND e.subject=$2 AND e.status='ACTIVE'
462:                       AND (e.valid_until IS NULL OR e.valid_until>clock_timestamp())
463:                     ORDER BY e.embedding <=> $3::halfvec NULLS LAST,e.edge_id LIMIT 200
464:                 ), node_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
465:                     SELECT n.* FROM companion_graph_nodes n WHERE n.user_id=$1 AND n.subject=$2 AND n.is_subject
466:                       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM companion_graph_edges e WHERE e.source_node_id=n.node_id AND e.status='ACTIVE')
467:                     ORDER BY n.embedding <=> $3::halfvec NULLS LAST,n.node_id LIMIT 100
468:                 ), facts AS (
469:                     SELECT n.name,n.entity_type,n.salience,n.subject,e.relationship_type,t.name AS related_to,
470:                            e.valence,e.intensity,e.source_episode_id,1-(e.embedding <=> $3::halfvec) AS relevance
471:                     FROM edge_candidates e JOIN companion_graph_nodes n ON n.node_id=e.source_node_id
472:                     JOIN companion_graph_nodes t ON t.node_id=e.target_node_id
473:                     UNION ALL
474:                     SELECT name,entity_type,salience,subject,NULL,NULL,0,0.5,NULL,1-(embedding <=> $3::halfvec)
475:                     FROM node_candidates
476:                 ) SELECT * FROM facts
477:                 ORDER BY COALESCE(relevance,0)+0.01*LEAST(salience,5) DESC,name,relationship_type,related_to LIMIT $4
478:                 """,
479:                 user_id,
480:                 subject,
481:                 vector,
482:                 limit,
483:             )

485:         ephs = await conn.fetch(
486:             "SELECT description,expires_at FROM companion_ephemerals WHERE user_id=$1 AND expires_at>clock_timestamp() ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 20",

488:         )
489:         enabled = await conn.fetchval(
490:             "SELECT enabled FROM companion_memory_state WHERE user_id=$1", user_id
491:         )

493:         "ephemerals": [dict(r) for r in ephs],

650: async def _store_fact_conn(conn, fact: GraphFact) -> None:
651:     """Shared fact-storage helper (add_graph_fact body extracted for reuse)."""
652:     name = resolve_entity(fact.name)
653:     relationship_to = (
654:         resolve_entity(fact.relationship_to) if fact.relationship_to else None
655:     )
656:     relationship_type = normalize_relation(fact.relationship_type)
657:     subject = _normalize_subject(fact.subject)
658:     valence = max(-1.0, min(1.0, float(fact.valence or 0.0)))
659:     intensity = max(
660:         0.0, min(1.0, float(fact.intensity if fact.intensity is not None else 0.5))
661:     )
662:     source_episode_id = fact.source_episode_id or None
663: 
664:     if source_episode_id:
665:         from uuid import UUID
666: 
667:         try:
668:             episode_uuid = UUID(source_episode_id)
669:         except ValueError:
670:             raise HTTPException(422, "Invalid source episode ID")
671:         if not await conn.fetchval(
672:             "SELECT 1 FROM companion_episodes WHERE user_id=$1 AND episode_id=$2",
673:             fact.user_id,
674:             episode_uuid,
675:         ):
676:             raise HTTPException(403, "Source episode does not belong to this user")
677:     else:
678:         episode_uuid = None
679:     vector = (
680:         await _embed(
681:             f"{name} {relationship_type.replace(chr(95), chr(32))} {relationship_to}"
682:         )
683:         if relationship_to and relationship_type
684:         else None
685:     )
686:     async with conn.transaction():
687:         source = await _upsert_node(
688:             conn,
689:             fact.user_id,
690:             name,
691:             fact.entity_type,
692:             subject=subject,
693:             bump_salience=True,
694:         )

+async def test_swarm_worker_pull_mode_claims_next_task(client, agents, monkeypatch):
+    import re
+    from agents import swarm_agent
+
+    await post(
+        client,
+        "/swarm/tasks",
+        workflow_id="pull-wf",
+        task_name="summarize_text",
+        payload={"text": "hello"},
+    )
+
+    class PullWorkerModel:
+        async def ainvoke(self, messages):
+            results = [m for m in messages if m.type == "tool"]
+            if not results:
+                return AIMessage(
+                    content="",
+                    tool_calls=[
+                        {
+                            "id": "claim-next",
+                            "name": "claim_next_task",
+                            "args": {
+                                "agent_name": "summary-bot",
+                                "workflow_id": "pull-wf",
+                            },
+                        }
+                    ],
+                )
+            if len(results) == 1:
+                task_id = re.search(r"\(id: ([^,]+),", results[0].content).group(1)
+                lease = re.search(r"lease_token: ([^)]+)\)", results[0].content).group(1)
+                return AIMessage(
+                    content="",
+                    tool_calls=[
+                        {
+                            "id": "complete",
+                            "name": "complete_swarm_task",
+                            "args": {
+                                "task_id": task_id,
+                                "agent_name": "summary-bot",
+                                "lease_token": lease,
+                                "result_summary": "pulled and completed",
+                            },
+                        }
+                    ],
+                )
+            return AIMessage(content="pulled and completed")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(swarm_agent, "llm_with_tools", PullWorkerModel())
+    out = await swarm_agent.worker_node(
+        {
+            "workflow_id": "pull-wf",
+            "worker_task": {},
+            "agent_name": "summary-bot",
+        }
+    )
+    assert len(out["messages"]) == 1
+    assert "pulled and completed" in out["reports"][0]
+    tasks = await get(client, "/swarm/tasks/pull-wf")
+    assert len(tasks) == 1 and tasks[0]["status"] == "COMPLETED"
+
+
+async def test_demo_seed_data_populates_canonical_patterns(client, agents, monkeypatch):
+    import main as demo_main
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(demo_main, "MEMORY_ENGINE_URL", str(client.base_url).rstrip("/"))
+    await demo_main.seed_data(client)
+
+    # Pattern 2: High-score trajectory recalled, low-score (0.20) excluded by quality gate
+    trajs = await post(
+        client,
+        "/task/trajectories/search",
+        goal_description="Write a Python script to count words",
+        agent_id="task-bot-2",
+        min_success_score=0.7,
+    )
+    assert trajs and all(t["success_score"] >= 0.7 for t in trajs)
+
+    # Pattern 4: Ebbinghaus decay turns 15-day-old 0.85 mastery into a gap (<0.7)
+    gaps = {
+        g["skill_name"]: g
+        for g in await get(client, "/tutor/gaps/learner_001")
+    }
+    assert gaps["python_basics"]["status"] == "mastered"
+    assert gaps["database_design"]["status"] == "gap"
+    assert gaps["database_design"]["decayed_score"] < 0.45
+
+    # Pattern 6: Canonical subject-first edges + common ground between user and Iris
+    ctx = await get(client, "/companion/context", user_id="usr_anthony")
+    common = agents.companion._find_common_ground(
+        ctx["graph_facts"], ctx["self_facts"]
+    )
+    assert "long conversations" in common
+
